author: researcher
excerpt:
// R22: Home weekly averages. A week runs Monday to Sunday in local calendar
// days. Averages cover tracked days only, so a missing day is never a zero.
observation: Our R22 domain code. weekDayKeys returns the seven local-calendar day keys of the Monday-first week containing the given time. Sleep averages use only days present in the sleep log; calorie averages use only days with at least one food entry. The current week and the previous Monday-to-Sunday week are averaged separately; change is thisWeek minus lastWeek and is present only when both weeks have data. Nothing records how many days were averaged.
limitations: Source code read at one commit; not a test of the running app. Says nothing about competitors.
